name: Criminal IP (asset API and search pages)
tier_rationale: Commercial CTI search engine of AI Spera (KR) with published terms and paid plans. P048's chair rationale says trusted, but P057 lists 'community - FOFA (CN), Criminal IP (KR)': the stricter statement applies (a fragment may only be stricter).

reliability.justification: Internet-wide scan observations and vendor risk scores: one vote, never 'malicious' alone; port and vulnerability data are version-inferred (P048).

criminalip.plan_hint: a company/team account on a plan recorded by legal (key_plans.criminalip = 'business') before it runs under corporate (P048); its monthly credits go into the P334 budget

asset_api.title: Criminal IP asset API /v1/asset/ip/report (domain scan endpoints are active and never wired)

terms.quote: Requires key 'criminalip' in config.KNOWN_KEYS (V3LUM_CRIMINALIP_KEY as alias), sent in the x-api-key header. Key-terms: a company/team account on a plan recorded by legal before it runs under corporate.

asset_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P048 cond 2). api.criminalip.io/v1/asset/ip/report?ip= and domain report lookups of existing data only (research C0099); /v1/domain/scan makes Criminal IP crawl the target and is never wired in any mode (P048), hence fetches_target false. HTTP 200 with body status 403 ('check access failed') maps to NEEDS_KEY/ERROR through a P321 marker the owning batch adds with its fixture, never EMPTY.

search_pages.title: Criminal IP asset report and search pages (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: FOFA and Criminal IP carry a 'foreign provider: queries are logged abroad - never paste internal host names' badge (legal_dpo, osint_investigator) and max_tlp=green: at TLP:AMBER and above they are hidden from reports and listed only by `v3lum links` with the warning (redteam_lead).

search_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (P057 cond 10). Class 'open' is the P057/P062 chair-file class for manual links. search.criminalip.io/asset/report/{ip} (the P048 manual link, research C0132) and asset/search?query=favicon: {h} (P062). V3LUM never fetches pivot links itself (P311).

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G14-1, p3-G02-1, p9-G03-1: batches only extend it (criminalip__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). No quota block: the company plan's monthly credits are not recorded yet (no published or observed figure in the research); add them when legal records key_plans.criminalip. Error-in-200 markers come from the owning batch with fixtures. The foreign-provider badge and max_tlp=green apply to the pivot links (P057).
